##Part B: 
##B1: 
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
students

##B2: 

str(students)
dim(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)

##B3: Calculate Student Average

students$average <- round(rowMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1)
students

##B4: 

students$passed <- students$average >= 72 & students$attendance >= 75
students

##B5: Standing Classification

students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                     ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))
students

##B6: 

classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    return("Distinction")
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    return("Merit")
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else {
    return("Fail")
  }
}

sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
```
##Part C: rbind() and cbind()
##C1:
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average <- round(rowMeans(new_students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 72 & new_students$attendance >= 75
new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                         ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
students_all
```

##C2: 
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz)
class(students_all)
students_all
```
##C3: 
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)
m_with_mean <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
m_with_mean
```
##C4: 
```{r}

bad <- data.frame(id = 11, student_name = "Katy") # Incorrect column name

tryCatch(
  rbind(students, bad),
  error = function(e) {
    message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)
```
##Explanation: rbind() requires all data frames to have identical column names and structures. If names differ (like student_name vs name), R cannot combine the rows and throws an error.
Part D: Subsetting
##D1: 
```{r}
students_all$name
students_all[["name"]]
students_all[, "name"]

##D2: 

students_all[2:5, c("name", "midterm", "final")]

##D3: 
##Logical Subsetting (Attendance > 90)

students_all[students_all$attendance > 90, ]

##D4: 
##Conditional Subsetting with subset()

subset(
  students_all, 
  sex == "F" & (section == "A" | section == "C") & final >= 75, 
  select = c("name", "section", "final")
)

##D5: 

# Highest average
students_all$name[which.max(students_all$average)]

# Lowest average
students_all$name[which.min(students_all$average)]

##D6: 
##Sort by Average (Top 3)

students_sorted <- students_all[order(-students_all$average), ]
head(students_sorted, 3)
```
##Part E: 
```{r}
##E1: Convert Factor Columns

students_all$section <- factor(students_all$section)
students_all$sex <- factor(students_all$sex)

levels(students_all$section)
levels(students_all$sex)

##E2

table(students_all$sex, students_all$section)

##E3: 

as.integer(students_all$sex)

##Explanation: Under the factor levels, R stores factors as integers based on alphabetical order (e.g., 1 for "F" and 2 for "M").
##E4: 

sex_label <- factor(students_all$sex, levels = c("F", "M"), labels = c("Female", "Male"))
students_all$sex_label <- sex_label
levels(students_all$sex_label)

##E5: 

summary(students_all$sex_label)


mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Female"])


mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Male"])
```
